name: Veronika Cifrová Ostrihoňová - Après le considérant E - Am 3
title: REPORT on public access to documents – report covering the years 2022 - 2024
part_text: Eb. Whereas although the ECA report stressed that it is permitted for NGOs to receive grants to support their operating costs, including advocacy, in its audit, the ECA clearly states that the Commission does not disclose information on the advocacy activities financed; whereas private citizens and MEPs have repeatedly requested access to Commission contracts with NGOs without success;
